'''Yeye''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yeye:''' Tell you what, Mister [[Yuanwu]]'s got really awesome boxing moves!
:'''Yeye:''' See these muscles? I bet you wouldn't even believe it if I told you I used to get sick all the time back in the day. I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my bigger brother looking after me.
:'''Yeye:''' He joined the [[Midnight Rangers|Rangers]] after I got older, so I went ahead to take boxing lessons from Mister Yuanwu, and he'd offer me Trine Tea after each session. Man, boxing really gets your body going!
:{{DIcon}} Can't say no to that.
:'''Yeye:''' Hehe. I need to put in some more practice, that way one day I can be just as strong as that girl [[Jianxin]]!
:'''Yeye:''' And by then, I'll be the one that's protecting my brother!
{{Dialogue End}}
